sunoData.title: Orbital Transit Loop
sunoData.tags: Ambient sci-fi game music with sleek downtempo pulse and soft syncopated motion; verses-like layers cycle through station hum, glassy arps, and restrained sub-bass while zone changes add filtered pads, ticking percussion, and rising synth clusters. Midsection opens into wider harmony, then returns to a calmer loop with subtle variations. Airy transitions, reversed swells, digital chimes, and faint radar blips. Clean, spacious, glossy mix with a futuristic neon sheen., ambient
